fixed_predictions: Both-correct hidden operators have higher heldout-ci accuracy than each of the other three conditions; compare paired outcomes without imposing a single-correct ordering.
Both-correct collision-ci accuracy exceeds the visible-answer-only0.5 ceiling in each of the three frozen-source means.
Both-correct collision-ci pair-both-correct is positive in each source mean.
Output-space operators, true-intermediate diagnostics, all single-step scores and all failures are reported; none are used to select fitting settings.
scope: Conditional prospective fresh four-way joint study with16-fold visible input coverage. Start only after the registered one-source visible-only coverage pilot passes; otherwise no confirmation data or compound predictions. All24 complete fixed10-epoch fits precede test opening. Only e/C/I enter training and validation. Same readout, native labels, native KD, operator-output KD, exact input marginals and budget across four conditions; only geometric pairing changes. Six fresh fitting pools reuse three existing source initializations. CI is primary; IC is answer-degenerate. Composition order is supplied. The90% single-generator interpretation gate in each source mean still applies to the final study.
interpretation_gate: Before interpreting hidden-composition failure, both correct single-generator validation accuracies must exceed0.90 in each of the three source means; report failure if unmet. Source native observed-state accuracy and each control operator accuracy are reported separately.
